name: Conduit Change Memory
description: Record post-delivery Conduit change memory, extract reusable project facts, and suggest Skill maintenance after test-repair-pr.

verificationSteps: Use taskSpec, changedFiles, testRuns, failureAnalysis, prDraft, discoveredFacts, and skillOutputs as evidence.
Separate one-time episodic history from reusable project facts and procedural Skill maintenance suggestions.
Mark stale or superseded facts as invalidated instead of deleting them.
Do not convert unverified target repository paths into permanent project facts.

safeDefaults: If evidence is incomplete, write an episodic journal entry but do not add stable project facts.
If a discovered fact conflicts with an existing memory, suggest invalidation instead of overwriting silently.
If another Skill may be stale, output skillImpactAnalysis instead of editing that Skill directly.
confirmationDefaults: Treat target repository facts as guidance until reverified against TARGET_REPO_PATH.
Require explicit follow-up approval before applying suggested updates to other Skills.

forbiddenChanges: Other Skill files unless a separate maintenance task approves the change
successCriteria: A changeRecord summarizes the task, matched Skills, changed files, tests, and outcome.
memoryUpdates separate journal entries, stable facts, invalidations, and rollout summary path.
skillImpactAnalysis suggests changes to other Skills without applying them automatically.
writePlan restricts writes to this memory Skill's files unless separately approved.
No unverified Conduit path is stored as a permanent fact.
